name: SEW-WHAT?
description: Premium virgin-hair brand running its own SEW-WHAT? Creator Program on its own site: creators earn 10% commission on every sale through a unique referral link and personal discount code, paid monthly via PayPal, and the program page states twice that there is no cap on earnings. Creators must post at least twice a month; 5,000+ followers is preferred but micro-creators with strong engagement are accepted.

evidence.summary: SEW-WHAT?'s own Creator Program page recruits beauty, hair and lifestyle content creators (stylists/salon owners are also welcomed, but the program is creator-first with Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/blog content expectations), gives each approved creator a unique referral link, a personal discount code and a creator dashboard, and requires at least 2 posts per month; 5,000+ followers is preferred, with micro-creators accepted on engagement.

The brand's own page publishes the commission structure: 'Earn 10% commission on every sale', monthly payouts via PayPal on the 1st of the month for the previous month's approved sales, plus performance-based bonuses.

The brand's own page states the earnings cap explicitly twice: 'No earning cap' in the commission structure list and 'There is no cap on earnings - the more you promote, the more you earn' in the program detail, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped. No absolute creator counts are published, so creator_saturation stays unknown.

opportunity.title: SEW-WHAT? Creator Program
opportunity.compensation_notes: 10% commission on every qualifying sale; monthly PayPal payouts; the brand's own page states there is no cap on earnings (verified uncapped). Performance-based bonuses available.
opportunity.description: Apply on the brand's Creator Program page, get a unique referral link and personal discount code, post at least twice a month featuring the hair products, and earn 10% on every sale with no earnings cap.

reasons.niche_fit: Premium virgin hair is highly visual, tutorial-friendly material for hair and beauty creators, though narrower than skincare or makeup.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-native program: referral links, personal codes, a creator dashboard, defined monthly content expectations across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and blogs, and social feature opportunities.
reasons.compensation: Clean 10% on every sale with an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page - verified uncapped - plus performance bonuses.
reasons.contact_access: Application and dashboard are on the brand's own site; no public program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application; 5,000+ followers preferred but micro-creators with strong engagement are accepted; a 2-posts-per-month commitment is required.
reasons.credibility: Smaller specialist brand; program terms are fully published on its own site, but scale and track record are modest.

name: Glo Skin Beauty
description: Pro-heritage mineral makeup and skincare brand whose own affiliate page splits the program in two: an Influencer route for influencers, publishers and fans with a social following, paying 10% commission on all new consumer orders, and a separate Professional route for existing trade accounts. The influencer program runs through Refersion, whose terms confirm the standard non-professional payout at 10% for new customers (1% for past purchasers).

evidence.summary: Glo Skin Beauty's own affiliate page offers two routes: 'For Influencers' - only for influencers, publishers and other fans of the brand with a social following - paying 10% commission on all new consumer orders with ongoing commission on associated customers; and 'For Professional Accounts' - only for current professional trade accounts - at 15%. Selected influencers earn on all net sales and receive free products monthly. Only the influencer route is recorded here; the professional route is a trade program.

The program's Refersion terms publish the Default Standard Payout (non-professional) at 10% commission for new customers and 1% for past purchasers/existing customers on MSRP orders, with a 30-day attribution window - matching the 10% influencer rate on the brand's page, which is the rate recorded. The same terms show a 20%/15% tier tied to keeping a Professional account active; that is the trade route and is not the creator rate. No earnings-cap statement or absolute creator counts are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

opportunity.title: Glo Skin Beauty Affiliate Program - Influencer Route (Refersion)
opportunity.compensation_notes: 10% commission on all new consumer orders for influencers (Refersion standard non-professional payout: 10% new customers, 1% past purchasers, MSRP orders only); ongoing commission on associated customers. A separate 15-20% professional trade route exists and is not the creator rate. No published earnings cap.
opportunity.description: Apply under the Influencer option on the brand's affiliate page, and if selected earn 10% on new consumer orders with free products monthly; tracking and terms run through Refersion.

reasons.niche_fit: Mineral makeup plus clinical skincare from a pro-heritage brand - strong tutorial, complexion and routine UGC material.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated influencer route on the brand's own page, explicitly for social followings, with free product for selected creators and Refersion tracking behind it.
reasons.compensation: 10% on new consumer orders is clean and confirmed in both the brand page and the Refersion terms; repeat-customer payout drops to 1% for non-professionals, and no uncapped statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Application is on the brand's own domain with a 48-hour follow-up promise if interested; no public program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Selective - the brand follows up only if interested - and the influencer route requires a social following.
reasons.credibility: Established professional beauty brand with complete, consistent terms published in two places (brand page and Refersion).

name: Shankara

evidence.summary: Shankara's own affiliate page states affiliates earn 'commission starting at 10% on every purchase made through your link and code', with bonuses and perks for high performers, free products and samples, exclusive discount codes, early access to launches and dedicated affiliate support; the application includes a brand education course and a 1:1 expert consultation, and there is no strict minimum sales requirement.

The brand's FAQ states sales are tracked through unique links on a 30-day cookie window and 'Payments are processed through the affiliate network (e.g., Awin) via methods like BACS or wire transfer', with schedule and thresholds set by the network - so the network is recorded as Awin per the brand's own wording. The recorded 10% is the published starting rate. The page publishes no earnings-cap statement and no creator counts, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

opportunity.title: Shankara Affiliate Program (Awin)
opportunity.compensation_notes: Commission starting at 10% on every purchase through the affiliate link and code, per the brand's own page; bonuses for high performers; payments via the affiliate network (Awin named on the page). No published earnings cap.
opportunity.description: Apply on the brand's affiliate page, complete the brand education course and 1:1 consultation, then earn starting at 10% on referred purchases with free products, samples and audience discount codes.

reasons.niche_fit: Ayurvedic, natural skincare with a strong ritual and ingredients story - good routine and wellness-led UGC material.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Brand-run affiliate page with link-and-code tracking, audience discount codes, free products and samples, and dedicated affiliate support.
reasons.compensation: Published starting rate of 10% with performance bonuses; the page does not publish the top of the range or any cap statement, so cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Full program page and FAQ on the brand's own domain; support is offered to affiliates, though no public program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with no strict minimum sales requirement; onboarding includes a required education course and consultation.
reasons.credibility: Established Ayurvedic brand with a stated humanitarian profit model and complete program terms on its own site.

name: Cult Beauty

The Awin commission-groups page publishes CPA by publisher type: Content 10% new customer / 5% existing, Shopping Directory 10%/5%, UGC & Communities 2%/2%, Influencer 1%/1%, with exclusions (0% gift cards, 1% electricals and selected brands, 2% advent calendars). opportunity.title: Cult Beauty Global Affiliate Programme (Awin)
opportunity.compensation_notes: Awin CPA by publisher type: Content 10% new / 5% existing customers; UGC & Communities 2%; Influencer 1% via Awin (influencer partnerships are managed in-house - see the published contact). No published earnings cap.

reasons.ugc_evidence: Awin programme with a dedicated UGC & Communities tier and an in-house influencer team; note the dedicated UGC network rate is only 2%, with the stronger 10% paid to Content publishers.
reasons.compensation: 10% new-customer rate for content publishers (5% existing) is solid for a retailer; UGC and influencer network tiers are much lower, and no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Published influencer partnership email on the Awin profile plus a dedicated in-house affiliate team.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Awin application for publishers; influencer partnerships are application-by-email to the in-house team.
reasons.credibility: Long-established UK prestige retailer (THG-owned) with a complete published Awin rate card.
